content.comment_body: Is it possible to modify the size of the text parameter object? We display temperature values with just 2 digits and do not need the default parameter object size of 7 cells in the [product_name] software ([article_no] module).
No, that's not possible. The parameter area size is set automatically to allow for the maximum value supported by the function block.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is having trouble resizing the text parameter object in the software. They only want to show a small value, but the interface forces the object to be larger than needed. This default sizing wastes space and prevents users from customizing the interface to their preferences.
analysis.user_expectations: The user hopes to have the option to resize the text parameter object so it better matches the actual data display requirements.
